correctness.rationale: The five P1--P5 laws match Holliday Definition 1; Chen Definition 3.3 adds conditional identity, semicomplementation and double-negation inflation. Antitone negation with inflation is self-adjoint, and a semicomplementation on P({1,2,3}) induces an undirected irreflexive relation; its common-neighbor polarity controls all unary row-zero entries. P3/P4 imply each row depends monotonically on A intersection B; with conditional identity the whole-universe row is identity, and the 2-atom rows have three candidate singleton values per side. Remaining P5 constraints reduce to singleton negation checks and give per-labeled-graph counts 729,81,16,1 for empty, single-edge, path and triangle; the sum 729+3*81+3*16+1=1021. Independently enumerated all graph-based candidate binary operations and directly checked every P1--P5 triple plus all extra laws, obtaining 1021. Recomputed S3 fixed counts (1021,41,41,10,10,41) and Burnside quotient 194. For arbitrary Y the explicit (A intersect B) union N(A\B) obeys every axiom by looplessness/antitonicity of common neighbors; the finite check is NOT offered as a proof for infinite Y.

originality.rationale: Holliday supplies the preconditional axioms and derived unary negation; Chen specifies the F subclass and general completeness/finite-model results. The actual exact three-atom Boolean conditional census (1021/194), its 4 graph-negation strata, and a direct universal graph construction are not contained in their consulted algebraic sections. Resultary finite-chain factorial censuses enumerate different carriers; a common unary polarity cannot determine binary conditional multiplicity, as the edgeless graph already admits 729 binary expansions.
residual_risks: An unindexed classification of Boolean conditional algebras under another term may yield equivalent operation tables.

The infinite graph witness is a constructive application of known polarity mechanics, so novelty lies in the precise F-conditional realization and finite census, not in graphs as unary polarities alone.
